newsitem.title: DENMARK: Dow seen pushing Danish shares to new record.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen pushing Danish shares to new record.

text.p: Friday's rises on Wall Street, spurred by low jobless figures, were seen pushing Danish share prices to new highs on Monday with foreign investors doing most of the buying.
"With good buying orders in, even before Friday's (unemployment) numbers, things look positive," a dealer said.
At 0745 GMT the KFX top-20 index stood at 168.72, 0.58 point up from Friday's close. Its June future rose 1.50 to 170.20.
Tel Danmark was expected to be the subject of continued attention, due to continued market talk that British Airways seeks a stake in the group.
Its share was up six crowns, to 345.00.

Novo Nordisk was expected to rise, in keeping with pharmaceutical sector rises in the United States, although in the first hour of trade in Copenhagen it was a modest one crown up, at 723.00. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
